summary: Session 2 of 2 — Release v1.2.0 (FINAL; set complete). NO product/classifier logic changed — only the version string and docs. (1) Bumped Directory.Build.props <Version> 1.1.0 -> 1.2.0 (single source of truth read by publish.ps1 and the CLI). Rebuilt + confirmed the binary reports `AccessHarvester 1.2.0 (schema v1.1)`; schema literal unchanged at v1.1. Verified the only version-asserting test (CliBootstrapTests) asserts just the substring 'schema v1.1' (still true), so the bump is test-neutral. (2) Confirmed main clean + green: dotnet build -c Release => 0 errors (1143 pre-existing CA1416 warnings); 2234 hermetic tests pass across 9 projects (Sql.Grammar 85, SymbolDb 70, Vba.Grammar 294, Vba.Parser 69, Vba.Resolver 400, TranslationProbe 9, Characterization 131, Pipeline.Tests 794, AccessHarvester.Tests 382 with the 6 COM-spawning classes filtered). The COM integration tier (AccessHarvester.Integration + the HomeHealthCareCom-collection classes) was EXCLUDED because a testhost wedged in post-COM native shutdown (known environmental flake; reaped via WMI Win32_Process.Terminate) — acceptable for this version+docs-only session per cross-provider verdict. (3) Release notes authored via route(documentation, gemini-pro) covering ALL consumer-visible changes since the v1.1.0 tag (not just sets 001/002), because v1.1.0 was an unpublished CI draft and the intervening sets all targeted v1.2.0: generate-migration capstone, report-baseline DisplayTotals, classify shutdown-hang fix, set-001 usage signals, set-001/002 narrowed cleanup. (4) Refreshed docs/harvester/install.md: version examples -> 1.2.0/schema-v1.1, both --version example outputs corrected, and the stale validate 'schema v1.0' refs fixed (binary embeds both v1.0 and v1.1 and validates against the manifest's declared schemaVersion). (5) Packaged via tools/publish/publish.ps1 (local smoke build; its SHA differed from CI's, confirming cross-machine non-determinism and that the CI artifact must be authoritative). (6) Cut the release via the established CI path: explicit maintainer go-ahead obtained BEFORE the tag push (spec stop rule + verifier issue #2); pushed tag v1.2.0; GitHub Actions (release.yml) built the deterministic win-x64 bundle and created the draft. Downloaded + checksum-verified the CI artifact (SHA-256 3820e6000fca44320fb4180d26137ad1f6dba213c4050f5b8daf993d4ee27b53), extracted + smoke-checked the released exe (--version => 1.2.0), set the release body to the authored notes with the real SHA, and PUBLISHED v1.2.0 as Latest (zip + .sha256). Cross-provider verification (gpt-5-4): R1 ISSUES_FOUND (3: stale install.md validate schema refs [fixed]; publish-discipline / approval-before-tag-push [honored]; ambiguous 'schema unchanged' wording [fixed]) -> R2 VERIFIED. Router note surfaced to maintainer: task_type='summarization' currently 400s against gemini-2.5-pro (config bug; documentation/analysis paths work) — routed change-log via documentation as a workaround.
